changes: Added docs/requirements/decisions/root-markdown-migration-execution-solution.md with allowed root set, migration batches, canonical destinations, stub/delete rules, reference checks, validation gates, and no-overclaim boundary. Updated root-document-migration-guide.md so jek.md stays user-owned at root and the legacy Koala root guide is a retirement target. Updated NAV to include the new decision doc and count 37 decision files.
usage: Use docs/requirements/decisions/root-markdown-migration-execution-solution.md before opening implementation stories that move or delete agent-generated root Markdown files. Use the validation gates in that document as the checklist for future cleanup batches.
expectedOutcome: User sees a new execution-plan decision doc and the existing root migration guide no longer treats the legacy Koala root guide as an allowed retained root file.
actualTranscript: validate --story=B-0b9b --json returned status=pass and allPass=true. npm test passed and verification coverage is 6/6 covered for CHK-001 and CHK-002.
outcomeDiff: No difference: the durable execution document exists, NAV is updated, and the prior guide now treats KOALA.md as retirement target while preserving jek.md at root.
limitations: This story writes the execution solution only. It intentionally does not move, delete, or rewrite root Markdown files; future implementation stories must perform the actual cleanup.
pitfalls: The first validation failed because the fresh worktree lacked package dist output; installing root dependencies, symlinking packages/main node_modules from the main local workspace, and running packages/main build produced the required dist task. A review check also caught ambiguous retained-root wording, which was removed before final validation.
